absorption: Upstream adopts an equivalent guard for the local dev stack: the project is renamed away from the generic `honcho` namespace, the api/deriver services are gated behind a profile so a plain `up` starts only database/redis, and the deriver stays on the project network instead of external `honcho_data`/`outbound` networks.

consumers.name: Local dev deployments that must never shadow the Saga-hosted production Honcho stack or squat on the `honcho-*` container namespace.

contract: The local dev stack template is named `honcho-dev`; the `api` and `deriver` services are gated behind the `app` profile so a plain `docker compose up` starts only `database` and `redis`; the `deriver` remains on the project network and never joins external `honcho_data`/`outbound` networks.

fork: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml.example config --format json | python -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d["name"] == "honcho-dev", d.get("name"); assert set(d["services"]) == {"database","redis"}, set(d["services"]); print("dev-compose-default-ok")'

docker compose --profile app -f docker-compose.yml.example config --format json | python -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d["name"] == "honcho-dev", d.get("name"); assert set(d["services"]) == {"api","deriver","database","redis"}, set(d["services"]); assert d["services"]["api"]["profiles"] == ["app"], d["services"]["api"].get("profiles"); assert d["services"]["deriver"]["profiles"] == ["app"], d["services"]["deriver"].get("profiles"); assert set(d["services"]["deriver"].get("networks", {})) == {"default"}, d["services"]["deriver"].get("networks"); print("dev-compose-app-ok")'
proof.fork_expected: the merged Compose model is named honcho-dev; a plain render exposes only database/redis, and the app-profile render adds api/deriver behind the app profile with the deriver on the project network only.
upstream: Inspect the recorded upstream base docker-compose.yml.example; the project name and profile gating must be absent.
proof.upstream_expected: the base template does not rename the project nor gate app services behind a profile.

replay: Reapply the guard (honcho-dev project name, `app` profile gating for api/deriver, no external networks on deriver) to docker-compose.yml.example on the next upstream update, and mirror it in the fork's docker-compose.yml.
upstream_gap: The pristine upstream template stands up a parallel Honcho application stack under the generic `honcho` project namespace with no profile gating, which can shadow the Saga production deployment.
